name: Zona
source:
A member of the Succubus tribe. She is Belbel's companion and friend. She is a gal-like succubus with long hair. 

She is older than Bel and Niqe, and is like an older sister to them. She lives on Mt Sabato, where she creates medicines and dances on request.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/103kyonyu5/#character]official site[/url]]
